newsitem.title: GERMANY: Further official gold sales not ruled out-Dresdner.
newsitem.headline: Further official gold sales not ruled out-Dresdner.

text.p: Further gold sales by central banks cannot be ruled out after the latest confirmation of recent sales by Australia's central bank, Dresdner Kleinwort Benson said in a market report on Friday.
Australia said on Thursday it had sold 167 tonnes over the last six months, triggering price falls to 12-year lows as disappointed speculators and institutions fled gold.
Dresdner said official gold sales by producer countries could be counterproductive because they were eroding cash bullion prices.
This could harm gold export earnings and threaten mines in countries with high cost structures.
The bank said it would favour official gold sales in the form of coin issues and auctions rather than sudden news of past sales which caused chaos in the market.
